overview: Umbrella review of systematic reviews of interventions to increase appropriate anticoagulation in adults with atrial fibrillation, reported with PRIOR, using the health board library's search, AMSTAR 2 appraisal and a citation matrix for overlap.
population: Reviews of adults with atrial fibrillation eligible for anticoagulation, in primary care or in programmes acting on primary care lists; hospital-only programmes are included only if they report effects on the primary care population after discharge.
exposure: Interventions aimed at patients (pharmacist-led review, decision aids), prescribers (prompts, education) or practices (feedback, facilitation), alone or combined.
procedures: The library searches four bibliographic databases and two review registers from inception, with forward citation searching of the four leads. Two reviewers screen titles and full texts; the analyst extracts review characteristics, effects and PROGRESS-Plus population descriptors; each review is rated with AMSTAR 2; overlap is measured as the corrected covered area. The protocol is registered before screening.

outcomes.name: Appropriate anticoagulation
outcomes.measure: Change in the proportion of eligible patients prescribed an oral anticoagulant, as reported by each review
outcomes.why: The register's gap and the board's target.

outcomes.name: Ischaemic stroke
outcomes.measure: Stroke events or rates where reviews report them
outcomes.why: The outcome anticoagulation is meant to prevent.

outcomes.name: Decisional conflict and knowledge
outcomes.measure: Patient-reported decision quality measures where reported
outcomes.why: An informed decline is a legitimate result.

outcomes.name: Review overlap
outcomes.measure: Corrected covered area across included reviews

feasibility: About 120 analyst hours (four hours a week for 30 weeks) plus 30 library hours cover the expected workload; see the analysis stage.
biasMitigation: Two independent reviewers for inclusion and AMSTAR 2
Citation matrix before any comparison of effects
Prescribing labelled as a process outcome in every summary

biasFlags.label: Overlap between reviews
biasFlags.note: Shared primary studies inflate agreement; handled with the corrected covered area.

biasFlags.label: Low-quality reviews
biasFlags.note: AMSTAR 2 ratings shown beside every effect.

biasFlags.label: Publication and reporting bias in primary studies
biasFlags.note: Inherited from the reviews; stated, not corrected.

flags: No new pooling unless overlap is low and reviews are compatible
parsimony.simplestPath: One overview question, one primary outcome, narrative and tabular comparison by intervention level.

theoreticalFramework: Interventions grouped by level (patient, prescriber, practice) for the comparison; no other framework.
summary: Registered umbrella review with AMSTAR 2, overlap assessment and one primary review-level outcome.
